description:

Britain in the 00s had some great number one singles. Songs that summed up a moment, stretched the boundaries of what pop could be, yet have stood the test of time. “Stan”. “Can’t Get You Out Of My Head”. “I Bet You Look Good on the Dancefloor”. “Umbrella”. “Bad Romance”. From this list you would think the British record buying public had excellent, undeniable taste. But then there are other songs where you wonder “how did that become the most popular song in the country?” Whether that’s because it’s defiantly uncommercial, a random novelty or just offensively not very good. Does this make them bad? Not necessarily, but it's weird they topped the UK charts. This is an exploration of those songs, the stories of the Most Bizarre UK No. 1s of the 2000s.

#00sPop #musiclist
